author: bardic-inspiration
name: Graveyard Ambush
summary: Ghouls and walking dead burst from the turned earth of Prod's graveyard.

parts.text: The fresh graves aren't fresh burials. The earth heaves, and grey hands claw out of every mound at once, while something larger drops from the chapel's bell tower.

The cult seeded the graveyard to stop travelers reaching the keep. The {ref:creature/rotwalker}s shamble forward first; the {ref:creature/ghoul} and the {ref:creature/ghast} wait until someone is {ref:condition/paralyzed}, then drag them toward the Collapsed Chapel. None of them flee.

parts.example: The rotwalkers rise in a ring around the party. On the second round the ghast drops from the bell tower onto whoever is at the back, and the ghoul follows its stench in.
